4, 5(j)(ii), 5(1), 6 OF POCSO OF ACT, 2012 AND SEC. 9 OF PROHIBITION OF CHILD MARRIAGE ACT, 2006, PENDING ON THE FILE OF SPECIAL 2ND ADDL. DISTRICT AND SESSION JUDGE, CHITRADURGA.

THIS PETITION IS COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

This petition is preferred under Section 438 Cr.P.C. praying to release the petitioner on anticipatory bail in the event of his arrest in Cr.No.163/2023 of Rampura Police Station, registered for the offence punishable under Section 376(2)(n), 376(3) of IPC, Section 4(2), 5(j)(ii), 5(L), 6(1) of POCSO Act, 2012 and Section 9 of Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006.
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner, the learned High Court Pleader for respondent-State, learned counsel for respondent No.2-victim's father and perused the material on record.

3. It is the case of prosecution that the petitioner has married a minor girl aged below 18 years on 22.12.2022 at one Maramma Temple and then committed sexual intercourse with her, on account of which she became pregnant.
4. Law is set into motion on a complaint lodged by the Medical Officer, Town Primary Health Care Centre, Challakere, Chitradurga.

sentences.text: Petitioner is none other than the maternal uncle of the victim.
The marriage took place on 22.12.2022.
Till the complaint was lodged on 25.11.2023, no one complained against the petitioner.
The prosecution is relying on the school records wherein the date of birth of the victim is mentioned as 17.02.2005.
If the same is taken into consideration, the victim was aged about 17 years 08 months at the time of marriage.
However, the learned counsel for the petitioner has disputed the age of the victim.
He contends that the victim was not a minor as on the date of her marriage with the petitioner.
6. The learned counsel for respondent no.2 submits that he has no objection to consider the prayer of the petitioner for bail.
7. The prosecution has to establish that the victim was a minor as on the date of commission of the offence in a full fledged trial, by placing acceptable document in proof of her age.
Considering the material on record and facts and circumstances of the case, the relief sought by NC: 2024:KHC:6763 the petitioner can be granted by imposing conditions.

Hence, the following:
ORDER i. Petition is allowed.
ii. Petitioner/accused in Crime No.163/2023 of Rampura Police Station, shall be released in the event of his arrest, subject to following conditions:
a.

He shall appear before the Investigation Officer within a period of one week from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and shall execute a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- [Rupees fifty thousand only] with two sureties for the likesum.
b. He shall cooperate with the investigation and shall not tamper with the prosecution witnesses in any manner.
c. He shall be available for the investigation of the case, whenever required.
He shall furnish proof of his residential address and shall inform the I.O/Court regarding change in the address, if any.
e. He shall appear before the Court on every date of hearing, without fail.

SD/-
